name: Beginner Full Body
description: Perfect for getting started with fitness

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Start in plank position, lower chest to ground, push back up
exercises.tips: Keep core tight, don't let hips sag

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows
exercises.instructions: Bend forward, pull dumbbells to chest
exercises.tips: Keep back straight, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.tips: Keep core engaged, don't arch back

exercises.name: Bicep Curls
exercises.tips: Keep elbows at sides, control the weight

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.instructions: Use chair or bench, lower body down and push up

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, squat down
exercises.tips: Keep chest up, knees behind toes

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward into lunge position, alternate legs

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, lift hips up squeezing glutes

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.instructions: Rise up on toes, lower slowly
exercises.tips: Control the movement, feel the stretch

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Squat down, jump back to plank, do push-up, jump forward, jump up
exercises.tips: Modify by stepping instead of jumping

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: In plank position, alternate bringing knees to chest
exercises.tips: Keep core tight, maintain plank position

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead
exercises.tips: Land softly, keep knees slightly bent
